subject: DT's package tables display locally but not when app deployed

messages.author: e9ea40ad71e07dc0
messages.subject: DT's package tables display locally but not when app deployed
parts:
I installed the DT package from recent Rstudio webinar by Yihui Xie, it made awesome tables and I combined several extensions, TableTools, Scroller, Fixed Columns.

Works great from Rstudio listening locally.

But when I deployedApp() to shinyi.o the tables don't show.

Admittedly, I'm in a little over m head. I started going through the FAQ here, but doesn't seem to be the issue. Its working on my machine.
https://datatables.net/manual/tech-notes/1

Is there anything special I have to do to get the app to display the tables when running from the server (shinyapps i.o)
Thanks,
Mike
